name: Copilot Setup Steps

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'src/**'
      - 'crates/**'
      - 'npm/**'
      - 'Cargo.toml'
      - 'package.json'
      - 'AGENTS.md'
      - '.github/workflows/copilot-setup-steps.yml'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'src/**'
      - 'crates/**'
      - 'npm/**'
      - 'Cargo.toml'
      - 'package.json'
      - 'AGENTS.md'
      - '.github/workflows/copilot-setup-steps.yml'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  generate-ai-context:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          components: rustfmt, clippy

      - name: Install Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Install just
        uses: extractions/setup-just@v2

      - name: Cache cargo registry
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cargo/registry
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-registry-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-registry-

      - name: Cache cargo index
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cargo/git
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-index-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-index-

      - name: Generate Rust Documentation
        run: |
          mkdir -p ai-context/docs
          cargo doc --no-deps --workspace 2>&1 | tee ai-context/cargo-doc.log
          # Extract public API items for AI context
          find target/doc -name "*.html" -type f | head -20 > ai-context/rust-doc-files.txt
          echo "Rust documentation generated."

      - name: Extract TypeScript Definitions
        run: |
          mkdir -p ai-context/types
          npm install
          # If types are generated via build, run build
          npm run build || true
          # Copy generated .d.ts files if they exist
          find . -name "*.d.ts" -not -path "./node_modules/*" -exec cp {} ai-context/types/ \; 2>/dev/null || true
          echo "TypeScript definitions extracted."

      - name: Analyze Code Structure
        run: |
          mkdir -p ai-context/structure
          # List source files with brief description based on name/path
          find src crates -name "*.rs" -type f | sort > ai-context/structure/rust-files.txt
          find npm -name "*.ts" -o -name "*.js" -type f | sort > ai-context/structure/js-files.txt
          # Generate a simple tree view
          tree -L 3 --dirsfirst -I "target|node_modules|.git" > ai-context/structure/project-tree.txt 2>/dev/null || find . -maxdepth 3 -not -path "./target/*" -not -path "./node_modules/*" -not -path "./.git/*" | sort > ai-context/structure/project-tree.txt
          echo "Code structure analyzed."

      - name: Extract Configuration
        run: |
          mkdir -p ai-context/config
          # Extract key settings from Cargo.toml
          grep -E "^(name|version|edition|authors|description|repository|license|homepage|documentation|readme|keywords|categories)" Cargo.toml > ai-context/config/cargo-settings.txt 2>/dev/null || true
          # Extract key settings from package.json
          cat package.json > ai-context/config/package.json 2>/dev/null || true
          echo "Configuration extracted."

      - name: Map Test Architecture
        run: |
          mkdir -p ai-context/tests
          # Find test files
          find . -name "*test*.rs" -o -name "tests.rs" -o -path "*/tests/*" -name "*.rs" | grep -v target | sort > ai-context/tests/rust-tests.txt
          find . -name "*.test.ts" -o -name "*.spec.ts" -o -path "*/tests/*" -name "*.ts" | grep -v node_modules | sort > ai-context/tests/js-tests.txt
          # List just commands related to testing
          just --list 2>/dev/null | grep -i test > ai-context/tests/just-test-commands.txt || true
          echo "Test architecture mapped."

      - name: Validate AGENTS.md
        run: |
          if [ ! -f AGENTS.md ]; then
            echo "::error::AGENTS.md not found"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          # Check for required sections
          required_sections=("Project Overview" "Development Workflow" "Code Conventions" "Testing Strategy" "Common Patterns" "Performance Considerations" "Debugging")
          missing_sections=()
          
          for section in "${required_sections[@]}"; do
            if ! grep -q "$section" AGENTS.md; then
              missing_sections+=("$section")
            fi
          done
          
          if [ ${#missing_sections[@]} -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "::error::AGENTS.md is missing required sections: ${missing_sections[*]}"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          # Check for code examples (simple heuristic: look for code blocks)
          if ! grep -q '```' AGENTS.md; then
            echo "::warning::AGENTS.md does not contain any code examples"
          fi
          
          echo "AGENTS.md validation passed."

      - name: Create AI Context Bundle
        run: |
          mkdir -p ai-context-bundle
          cp -r ai-context/* ai-context-bundle/
          cp AGENTS.md ai-context-bundle/
          tar -czf ai-context-bundle.tar.gz -C ai-context-bundle .
          echo "AI Context Bundle created."

      - name: Upload AI Context Artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ai-context-bundle
          path: ai-context-bundle.tar.gz
          retention-days: 5
